requirements.question: For the assigned paper only, provide its documented facts needed to address: Compare BLIP-2 and Flamingo on vision encoder using only the prepared corpus.
requirements.claim:
The frozen image encoder is a pre-trained vision transformer (ViT); BLIP-2 explores ViT-L/14 from CLIP and ViT-G/14 from EVA-CLIP.
The vision encoder is used frozen, with two explored configurations: ViT-L/14 from CLIP (Radford et al., 2021) and ViT-G/14 from EVA-CLIP (Fang et al., 2022).
The last layer of the ViT is removed and the second-to-last layer's output features are used, which leads to slightly better performance.

requirements.question: For the assigned paper only, provide its documented facts needed to address: Compare BLIP-2 and Flamingo on vision encoder using only the prepared corpus.
requirements.claim:
The vision encoder is a pretrained Normalizer-Free ResNet (NFNet), specifically the F6 model, chosen for its performance/efficiency trade-off given the hardware.
The vision encoder is pretrained with a contrastive text-image objective (two-term contrastive loss, à la CLIP) on image-text pairs, and its weights are frozen during the main training phase of the Flamingo models.
The output of the final stage is a 2D spatial grid of features X_f; the role of the vision encoder is to extract semantic spatial features (color, shape, nature, positions of objects).
